column1: # /Data External Refresh — WAIT mode mid-flight (M12 v0.4 slice 4)
# /DER now runs the SQL on a background tokio task; the user sees
# WAIT + a "Refreshing <name>" hint on line 3 until the worker
# returns. BLOCK_NEXT_OP parks the op pre-spawn so the transcript
# can observe the WAIT frame deterministically.
# Connect "sales" and bind a query so /DER has something to re-run.
KEYS SELECT id, name, qty FROM items ORDER BY id
# Overwrite the bound cell so we can prove the refresh actually fires.
# Park the next op so the WAIT frame is observable.
# /DER sales — queues the refresh; mode flips to WAIT but the
# parked op hasn't run, so the cell still shows "junk".
# Drain the parked op. The worker runs, writes the records back, and
# the apply path returns the App to READY.
